title: A customer imported with a blank credit term gets the shop's default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, is the default for new customers.
  • Have a contacts import file with one new customer, customer A, whose credit term cell is empty.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes.
  • No row is refused because of its credit term.

Step 2:

  • The "Credit term" reads term A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S10-R1: “A customer created by the contacts import with a blank credit term gets the shop's default.”
  • Key Decisions: “Imports and the Public API stay lenient. A blank term gets the default; a name matching any of the shop's terms (standard or its own, active or deactivated, ignoring capitals and spaces) is saved as that term in its correct spelling, and a deactivated one then shows as "{name} (Inactive)"; any other text is saved as sent and dated as today.”
  • Goals: “A user with 'Settings → Finance' can set the default term for new customers to any active term except Credit Hold, and every customer created afterwards in ShopView, by contacts import or by the Public API without a term starts on it.”
